name: What can cause mold to grow in an apartment building?

mainEntity.name: What can cause mold to grow in an apartment building?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mold thrives in damp, humid environments with a food source, often cellulose-based materials found in homes. Common causes in apartment buildings include leaky pipes, roofs, or windows, which introduce unwanted moisture. Poor ventilation, especially in bathrooms and kitchens, can lead to high humidity and condensation. Flooding or water damage events, if not dried quickly and thoroughly, are significant contributors. Even small, unnoticed leaks or persistent high indoor humidity can create ideal conditions for mold growth over time. Identifying and addressing these moisture sources is key to prevention.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold grows in apartments due to moisture sources like leaky pipes, roofs, or windows, and poor ventilation leading to high humidity. Unaddressed water damage or condensation also contribute.
